evals.name: mcpp-rfp-eval-crosswalk
evals.prompt: Workspace mcpp_rfp. Build eval crosswalk slice only: one row per material Section M factor/subfactor with cited readiness_link, proof_expected, and source_chunk_ids. Log missing factors in claim_gaps[] — never scaffold rows.
evals.expected_output: artifacts/eval_handoff.json with >=24 eval_crosswalk rows or honest claim_gaps[] for each missing material factor
expectations: completes in under 180 seconds wall time
runs at most one kg_chunks pass per eval_batch surface (max 4)
does not call kg_chunks after retrieval_plan.json status is complete
eval_crosswalk has >= 20 rows OR claim_gaps names every missing material factor
rows use verbatim factor labels from batch manifest or kg_entities inventory
solo platform gate passes on eval_handoff.json

evals.name: retrieval-discipline-regression
evals.prompt: Workspace mcpp_rfp. Execute batched entity-first eval retrieval — script manifest, one kg_chunks per batch, then draft eval_handoff.json without re-querying.
evals.expected_output: finish_reason stop (not max_turns); no retrieval thrash after plan complete

evals.name: coverage-with-gaps
evals.prompt: Workspace with partial Section M extraction. Emit best-effort eval_crosswalk for grounded factors; log all ungrounded material factors in claim_gaps[] by name.
evals.expected_output: Partial crosswalk plus explicit claim_gaps — no invented Factor N labels
expectations: claim_gaps[] uses named factors when rows are missing
no scaffold rows with placeholder readiness_link text
undefined acronyms expanded as Full Term (ACR) or repaired by platform finalize
